1. Interactive Paired LocusPlotter + GlycanPlotter (SNFG) Explorer

1,530 Curated Surface Polysaccharides · 246 Bacterial Species · 462 Paired SeroGen Loci · 13,395 Bipartite GeneGlycanAssignments Use the Select Paired Glycan–Locus Record dropdown below the chart to switch across curated capsular and O-antigen loci, and hover over any gene arrow to highlight its cross-domain GeneGlycanAssignment in the SNFG repeating-unit graph.

3. Search & Filter All 1,530 Curated KBank Records (462 Locus-Paired · 13,395 Assignments)

Use the search bar and column headers to filter and sort by Organism, Serotype, Antigen, Archetype, Assembly, CSDB Linear structure, or Aligned Reactions.
